_comment: Example of an MCP tool that hands a decision back to a human via an MCP App. The tool references a ui:// resource the host renders as an interactive view; the user's choice flows back as the tool result. Adapt to your MCP server framework - the shape that matters is (1) a registered ui:// resource and (2) a tool that points at it.

resources.name: Confirm order
resources.description: Interactive order-confirmation card: line items, total, and a confirm / cancel control.

tools.name: confirm_order
tools.description: Present an order for human confirmation before charging. Renders an interactive confirmation card (MCP App) and returns the human's decision. Use at the final, irreversible step of a purchase.

line_items.description: Items to display in the confirmation card

_result_shape._comment: What the tool returns after the human acts - keep the machine-readable decision separate from the rendered view.
